location: New Haflong Railway Station & Jatinga Valley
description: Massive slope wash-away submerged New Haflong railway station yard, swept away passenger trains, and destroyed 38 bridges/culverts cutting off Barak Valley for 60 days.
geological_cause: Rapid pore-pressure surge in weathered Disang shale with surcharge load from unplanned hill road cutting.

trigger: Extreme Cloudburst Event (972 mm in 24 hrs at Cherrapunji)
description: Cascading debris flow destroyed 14 mountain hamlets, washed out NH-206 Shillong-Dawki highway sections, and generated major rock avalanches.
geological_cause: High hydraulic gradient in quartzite joints coupled with thin soil mantle detachment over bedrock.

location: Tupul Railway Yard & Ijei River Valley
trigger: Prolonged Rain causing Liquefaction of Cut-Slope Debris
description: Gigantic rotational landslide buried the Territorial Army camp, 107 railway construction workers, and dammed the Ijei River creating an imminent flash-flood risk.
geological_cause: Over-steepened artificial cut slope without toe retention; liquefaction of highly fractured clay-rich colluvium.

trigger: GLOF (Glacial Lake Outburst Flood) from South Lhonak Lake triggering massive collateral landslides
description: Teesta III Chungthang dam was washed away; catastrophic toe scour destabilized slopes across 70 km along NH-10.
geological_cause: Toe erosion from high-velocity hydraulic surges triggering multiple translational rockslides.

trigger: Cyclone Remal Heavy Rains (220 mm in 12h)
description: Illegal stone quarry slope collapsed onto residential settlements at Melthum; multiple secondary mudslides blocked NH-306.
geological_cause: Daylighting joints in dipping Surma sandstone beds undermined by uncontrolled quarry excavations.

description: Trans-Arunachal Highway blocked at 7 locations due to mud slips and culvert washouts.
geological_cause: Pore pressure buildup in phyllitic overburden.
